waves.fact: Canonical queue binds revision 14 to script 042, compressed payload 041, validation 021 and integrity validator 044 under the same logical task.
waves.guard: Reject any runtime output whose task, attempt, payload revision or script identity does not match the canonical revision-14 queue contract.

waves.fact: Revision-14 data-quality contract restricts direct HMLR monthly GML authority scope to London Borough of Barnet and London Borough of Enfield.
waves.guard: Reject candidate boundary evidence from an authority outside the canonical Barnet/Enfield scope.

waves.fact: Canonical contract requires the HMLR INSPIRE monthly publication dated 2026-07-05 and direct monthly GML refresh.
waves.guard: Reject stale or unproven HMLR geometry not tied to the required July 2026 monthly publication.

waves.fact: HMLR INSPIRE polygons provide indicative extent and position for registered freehold properties; they are not by themselves proof of the exact legal boundary.
waves.guard: Do not promote an INSPIRE polygon to exact legal-boundary status without the task's exact identity and geometry gates.

waves.fact: Revision-14 requires an exact INSPIRE identifier and proof that the candidate point lies inside the matched polygon.
waves.guard: Nearest, fuzzy or point-only fallback is forbidden when the exact INSPIRE identifier or inside-polygon proof is absent.

waves.fact: Revision-14 permits identical cross-authority duplicate polygons to be deduplicated.
waves.guard: Do not count identical Barnet/Enfield duplicate delivery as two separate parcel candidates.

waves.fact: Revision-14 rejects conflicting duplicate geometries for the same candidate identity.
waves.guard: Any conflicting Barnet/Enfield geometry keeps the candidate unmeasured and blocks numeric promotion.

waves.fact: HMLR monthly GML evidence used by the gate must be in British National Grid EPSG:27700.
waves.guard: Reject boundary geometry whose native or proven horizontal CRS is not EPSG:27700.

waves.fact: HMLR title plans normally show general boundaries unless a boundary has been determined under the statutory process.
waves.guard: Do not treat an ordinary title-plan line or INSPIRE extent as centimetre-accurate legal boundary evidence.

waves.fact: Determined-boundary guidance expects a sufficiently detailed plan and defined spatial relationship to permanent features.
waves.guard: Do not use determined-boundary accuracy claims unless the actual determined-boundary evidence exists for the candidate.

waves.fact: HMLR determined-boundary measurement guidance uses horizontal measurements with about +/-10 mm measurement tolerance from defined permanent features and National Grid controls where used.
waves.guard: Do not transfer determined-boundary survey tolerances to ordinary INSPIRE/title-plan geometry.

waves.fact: Canonical metric uses Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1m as the primary numeric elevation source.
waves.guard: No parcel height-difference may be promoted from OS Terrain 50/5 alone or from an unverified DEM substitute.
sources: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS

waves.fact: Revision-12 code resolves the EA DTM 1m WCS coverage and hashes capability/coverage responses before direct GeoTIFF sampling.
waves.guard: Reject an EA raster sample lacking direct coverage identity, response provenance or content integrity evidence.

waves.fact: Canonical revision-14 acceptance requires at least three valid EA DTM 1m pixel-center samples inside the fresh HMLR polygon.
waves.guard: Fewer than three valid EA pixels is NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED, not a measured parcel range.

waves.fact: Canonical height evidence uses Ordnance Datum Newlyn with vertical CRS EPSG:5701.
waves.guard: Reject mixing ellipsoidal, unknown or non-ODN heights with the parcel range or OS crosscheck.

waves.fact: EA LIDAR DTM source contract uses approximately +/-0.15 m RMSE vertical accuracy for contributing surveys.
waves.guard: Do not report file decimal precision as if it were survey accuracy; preserve the source error budget.

waves.fact: Time-stamped EA DTM metadata records survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal-model lineage.
waves.guard: Reject historic raster evidence whose survey/transform/geoid lineage cannot be reconciled with the claimed vertical datum.
sources: Environment Agency Time Stamped DTM metadata

waves.fact: Revision-14 requires the freshly downloaded HMLR polygon to be topologically equal to the geometry used for EA and OS sampling.
waves.guard: Reject numeric evidence if HMLR, EA and OS stages sampled different parcel geometry versions.

waves.fact: Canonical OS Terrain 50 role is independent absolute elevation and ODN consistency crosscheck, not parcel max-minus-min measurement.
waves.guard: Never promote a 50 m OS cell value into the parcel height-difference range.

waves.fact: OS Terrain 5 is a 5 m grid and its cell height represents the grid/pixel terrain value; decimal file precision is not equivalent to parcel-scale survey accuracy.
waves.guard: Use Terrain 5 only as secondary plausibility evidence unless the canonical metric explicitly changes.

waves.fact: HMLR, EA and OS sampling evidence must align in British National Grid EPSG:27700 for direct spatial comparison.
waves.guard: Reject silently reprojected candidate coordinates when the transformation provenance is absent or ambiguous.

waves.fact: Canonical contract sets maximum allowed EA-median versus OS absolute elevation difference at 8.0 m.
waves.guard: A difference over 8.0 m creates a conflict/human-review state and forbids measured-row promotion.

waves.fact: Revision-14 requires source page/GML hashes plus runner/web output identity and integrity readback consistency.
waves.guard: No numeric row is terminally trusted until source, runtime, web and integrity hashes/readbacks reconcile.

waves.fact: The tested revision-14 contract explicitly forbids nearest, fuzzy and point-only fallback for parcel identity/geometry.
waves.guard: Unresolved real candidate identity stays unresolved; do not invent INSPIRE IDs, coordinates or polygon matches.

waves.fact: Runtime network execution and remote integrity output are still required before any official measured height-difference row can be promoted.
waves.guard: While revision-14 runtime or integrity output is absent, official measured rows remain zero and final_ready remains false.
